summary: Marketing, finance, startups, career and productivity. Viewers want credible, actionable advice; specifics (numbers, examples, frameworks) separate signal from guru noise.

structure.goal: State the result with a number
Cost of doing it the usual way
Name it and list the 3 parts
Apply it to a real company or your own numbers
Offer the template or next step

archetypes.name: Case study
archetypes.when_to_use: Explaining why something worked or failed.

structure.goal: Who and what in two sentences
Ask for the next case to analyse
Invite a challenge in the comments

hook_styles.example: How I got my first 100 customers with zero ad spend

hook_styles.pattern: [Common advice] is the biggest mistake in [field]
hook_styles.example: Cold emailing is the biggest mistake new founders make
Are you still pricing by the hour?
Beginners chase followers. Pros chase email addresses

pacing.notes: Confident, even delivery; show numbers on screen the moment you say them.

shot_conventions.framing: face, eye-level, desk or office background
shot_conventions.b_roll: number or result as large on-screen text
shot_conventions.note: Say the number in the first sentence

shot_conventions.b_roll: chart or screenshot of the pain point

shot_conventions.framing: full screen list that builds point by point
shot_conventions.note: Reveal each point as you say it

shot_conventions.b_roll: real numbers with sensitive data blurred

cta_patterns: Download the free template in the description
Comment FRAMEWORK and I will send it
Follow for a new case study every week
common_risks: Income or growth claims without proof
Too many frameworks in one video
